title: Metabolomics and Statistical Analysis Tools
summary: This cluster is centered around various tools and methods used in metabolomics and statistical analysis. KEGG and BioCyc are linked through their association with ChEBI and LipidMAPS, indicating a connection between metabolic pathways and compound databases. Statistical tests are used in conjunction with several tools, including Jalview, NCBI's protein BLAST, and UniProt, to analyze protein sequences. Additionally, the cluster includes various tools used in metabolomics, such as MaxQuant, timsTOF, and mzVault, which are linked to compound databases and statistical analysis methods. The cluster also includes organism ρ+ and ρ0 cells, which are compared through statistical tests.
